lessons.title: Simple Cadences
lessons.summary: How a bass signals the end of a phrase.

content.title: Endings in the bass
body: A cadence closes a musical phrase. In the bass, the most common closing gesture is a leap from degree 5 to degree 1.

content.prompt: Which bass motion most strongly signals a full close?

answer.explanation: Dominant to tonic is the strongest closing motion.
